declined_reference_toctou_assessment.honest_assessment: The residual window between reference verify_reference_checkpoint and subsequent file reads remains. It is narrowed by generate_manifest's in-call re-verification of every checkpoint hash. Exploiting the remainder requires concurrent write access on the remote host during the run. No receipt-level binding can exclude a compromised host that rewrites bytes between check and use. The attempt-3 preregistration's conscious acceptance is accurate and consistent with the attempt-2 P3-C standard.
declined_reference_toctou_assessment.challenger_multi_load_note: Challenger snapshots are verified once per arm, then AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained may run twice (two LR fits) without re-verification. The window spanning an entire first fit is longer than the reference window. Exploitation still requires concurrent host write access during the run — the same P3 class, not elevated to P0 under the repository's established TOCTOU standard. Hardening (re-verify before each from_pretrained) is recommended but not required for go.

defects.title: Challenger from_pretrained is not preceded by per-fit re-verification
defects.detail: verify_challenger_snapshot runs once per arm; each learning-rate fit reloads weights from the same snapshot path without re-hashing. Concurrent host rewrite between fits could desynchronize the recorded snapshot_sha256 from the bytes actually trained on the second fit. Same exploitation class as the accepted reference TOCTOU (requires concurrent write access on the remote host). Informational; recommended hardening only.

defects.title: Frozen denylist omits later-declared product host 465072
defects.detail: AGENTS.md protects CPU VM 465072 (barun-action-demo-public-v1). The v3 denylist is the audited 18-ID sub100m copy and does not include 465072. enforce_machine_id would not reject it, but the runner's CUDA+bf16 requirement makes that host unusable for this sweep, and the authorized launch path creates a fresh H200 rather than reusing 465072. Informational.
